messages:
Ava (growth): thinking about a small experiment: embed a compact pricing estimator widget on the Docs pages (near quickstarts) instead of only on the pricing page. goal: reduce friction for devs who land in docs and push them to try hosted API. also want to test a new tier naming variant (Core / Scale / Enterprise -> Starter / Pro / Dedicated). thoughts? :thinking_face:
Miguel (analytics): curious — do we have baseline for doc-to-signup conversion? last quarter docs signups ~2.1% vs pricing page ~4.5%. if embed adds 0.5–1pp that would be solid. can run A/B by doc path.
Priya (sales): inbound routing note: if widget suggests Dedicated/Dedicated-ish tier, we should route to AE queue with priority tag. current inbound rules are keyword-based; new experiment should add `recommended_tier` in payload so we can triage.
Zara (design): mockup uploaded: https://figma.com/s/embedded-estimator — compact, single-input (monthly tokens) -> estimate + suggested tier chip. variant B shows tier labels as Starter/Pro/Dedicated. Variant A keeps Core/Scale/Enterprise.
Ava (growth): copy idea for estimator CTA -> `Estimate monthly cost` + small link `See pricing & FAQ`. Also want micro-FAQ under widget for: billing cadence, data retention, SLA.
Miguel (analytics): for tracking: please include `experiment_id`, `variant`, `recommended_tier`, `referrer=docs` in the event. I'll set up funnel dashboard.
Priya (sales): routing payload example pls, so my infra team can wire to Intercom webhook.
Ava (growth): pinging ops for payload — example:```{ "user_id": "<anon>", "monthly_tokens": 200000, "estimate_usd": 120, "recommended_tier": "Pro", "referrer": "docs" }```
OpsBot: deploy checklist created: #deploy-embed-widget, tested on staging, feature-flagged. rollout plan: 10% docs traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 72h.
Zara (design): quick UX ask — show `recommended_tier` with short rationale tooltip (e.g., "recommended for 200k tokens/mo") so users understand why.
Miguel (analytics): will instrument cohort analysis by initial doc path + variant. target metric: signups w/ paid intent within 14 days. secondary: outbound leads flagged for AE.
Priya (sales): if variant with Starter/Pro names yields more clicks to contact sales, we might be able to reduce AE routing for Starter and keep AE focus on Dedicated. will monitor sample.
Ava (growth): timeline: devs start this week, analytics hooked next week, run for 3 weeks. set up quick webinar mention in launch post? small 20-min explainer for large accounts about billing & dedicated capacity — link CTA in widget for Enterprise/Dedicated.
Zara (design): will add tiny CTA `Talk to sales` on Dedicated suggestion only.
Ava (growth): cool — Miguel/Priya/Zara I'll sync Friday to finalize payload & routing. :thumbsup:
